comment: The panel prints FREQ, BITE and MORPH, letters the state switch DEAD above and ALIVE below, and letters the outputs plus, minus and MAIN; the bias knob and the power jack carry no lettering of their own. The frequency knob's tooltip name, unit and scaling are rewritten each sample from the mode switch (src/Moxie.cpp:270-272 and 297-299), so it reads as a frequency in continuous mode and as a slope multiplier in slope mode. A fault in src/Moxie.cpp:57: the saved state for the Old Oscillator Models menu item is read back out of the 'dc' field rather than the 'old' one, so reloading a patch gives that setting whatever value the DC removal option had. The maker's manual describes the dead state as one oscillator waiting for the other; in the code it is a flip-flop that gates each half off until the other has fired.
